description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.
